entities.name: Wanda Dubieńska
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wanda Dubieńska born Nowak was a Polish fencer, tennis player, cross-country skier and sport celebrity and the daughter of Julian Nowak. She competed in the women's individual foil event at the 1924 Summer Olympics. She was the first woman to represent Poland at the Olympics. Dubieńska was buried in the Rakowicki Cemetery.
